svg.title: Mission Control — substrate canvas mid-mission
svg.desc: A mini Mission Control center pane: the real top chrome (brand, state, cost meter), the HUD counts and filter+legend row, a single live finding ticker, then the substrate canvas itself — preset gaps pulse, the user goal drops in, gap finding fans out children, drones orbit them, findings settle as satellites, a child fills, a parent rolls up. A sediment band and event tape close the panel.

g.text: DNS + Shopify storefront wired; staging green
